note: Lifecycle: locked -> active -> completed -> rewarded. 'start_flags' activate a locked quest, 'complete_flags' complete it, and the reward is granted once (tracked in rewards_claimed). Chapter 1 quests follow docs/chapter-01/data/chapter-01-quests.json.

journal.active: Lumi is waiting somewhere in Root Square.
journal.completed: Lumi joined the adventure. Well, the short, careful visit.

journal.active: Bobo will trade his lantern for the parcel a Leafling took into the Training Glade.
journal.completed: Bobo got his parcel back. We have a lantern!

journal.active: Find the gate key and a way across the Whispering Roots.
journal.completed: We found the gate key and rebuilt the root bridge.
The Thornkeeper let us pass. It said the promise hasn't ended.

journal.active: Open the Forbidden Gate and cross into the human world.
journal.completed: We made it to Sungai Melor!

journal.active: Humans can't see us! Find out how to get to Bandar Senja. Old Kettle in the kopitiam knows things.
journal.completed: We sorted Encik Lim's coins. Old Kettle told us the bus trick.

journal.active: Board the bus at the village road stop. Follow someone with a big load.
journal.completed: We rode the bus to Bandar Senja, on the luggage rack.

journal.active: A fisherman dropped his postcard on the jetty. Post it in Bandar Senja. Maybe the post box knows how.
Put Pak Darus's three parcels back on his desk while he isn't looking. A: the goods shed (west). B: the rail yard (through the hall). C: sent to the wrong shop on Shophouse Row (east).
journal.completed: All three parcels are back. The Clockkeeper owes us tickets.

journal.active: Parcel B is in a moth nest on a rail yard siding. Set the three signal levers to send the handcar there. Lumi's Echo Sight can show the old route.
journal.completed: We beat the Paper Moth Monarch and got Parcel B back. We learned Guardian Bloom.

journal.active: A 1951 parcel tag on the goods shed's high shelf has the same emblem as Reno's token. Lumi could read it with Memory Touch.
journal.completed: Footsteps on a platform, and a woman's voice: "Mind the gap, little one."

journal.active: Board the evening train at Platform 2 (north door of the Station Hall).
journal.completed: We boarded. Then the fog came.

journal.active: The passengers have lost where they were going. Memory Moths carry glowing slips. Get them back and give each slip to the passenger it belongs to.
journal.completed: Three passengers remember where they're going. The Guard's Van is open.

journal.active: Someone in the Guard's Van is collecting everyone's destinations. Our stamped tickets should keep ours safe.
journal.completed: The Conductor remembered he used to carry people home.

journal.active: The train has stopped at a ghost platform.
journal.completed: The river route is open. The rails forget; the river remembers.

journal.active: The lantern showed a Veil keyhole on a trunk in the Luggage Van. Something inside is grumpy.
journal.completed: We calmed the Lost Luggage and found a Brass Lantern Hook.
